title: Collect 60 Random Wikipedia Titles
goal: Starting at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random, use the browser UI only (no scripts, no APIs): click 'Random article' in the sidebar 60 times, one at a time, and after each click write down the article title. Return all 60 titles.

result.output_text:
I completed only **1 of 60** Random article clicks before the run’s time limit:

1. [Alma Reville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alma_Reville)

A coordinate-scaling error initially opened “Contact us”; correcting the coordinates produced the article above. The initial landing article is not counted.
